description: This file contains classes, functions, and logic for handling TLS configuration and fingerprinting for gateway connections in an Android app, including building TLS configs, probing TLS fingerprint, and managing trust managers.

classes.name: GatewayTlsParams
classes.description: Holds parameters required to configure TLS connection, such as expected fingerprint and whether to allow Trust-on-First-Use.

classes.name: GatewayTlsConfig
classes.description: Encapsulates the SSL socket factory, trust manager, and hostname verifier for TLS connections.

classes.name: GatewayTlsProbeFailure
classes.description: Enum representing failure reasons during TLS fingerprint probing.

classes.name: GatewayTlsProbeResult
classes.description: Contains the result of the TLS fingerprint probe, including the fingerprint and failure reason.

methods.name: buildGatewayTlsConfig
methods.description: Creates and returns a custom GatewayTlsConfig based on provided parameters, with optional fingerprint pinning and trust management.

methods.name: probeGatewayTlsFingerprint
methods.description: Performs a TLS handshake with a specified host and port to retrieve the certificate fingerprint for verification.
